summary: Over 4,000 products and 100+ brands organised into a wholesale storefront buyers can navigate.
challenge: A wholesale distributor needed thousands of products across more than a hundred brands to be browsable, not just listed.
approach: Set up a Shopify storefront structured for wholesale buying, with the catalogue organised by brand rather than dumped into one list.
Designed navigation and search around how buyers actually look for stock, which is what turned a large catalogue into a usable one.
metaTitle: Case Study: UAE wholesale fragrance distributor | TDM
metaDescription: Over 4,000 products and 100+ brands organised into a wholesale storefront buyers can navigate.
